patch.scope: Reference-only borrowed-result acknowledgement before a closed DERP bind returns; no wire format, profile, key, queue or timeout change. Independent LiuTangLei WireGuard v0.0.34 is unchanged.
patch.removal_condition: Remove when the pinned independent reference includes equivalent closed-bind borrowed-result acknowledgement and the focused Close/Open regression and race gate pass. Recheck source/hash pins on every reference revision change.

derp-borrowed-read-ack.patch.scope: Minimal DERP borrowed-read acknowledgement on closed bind; no diagnostics, packet/protocol changes, timeout or queue policy.
derp-borrowed-read-ack.patch.common_seam: Pinned Tailscale wgengine/magicsock/derp.go, connBind.receiveDERP: call dm.copyBuf(nil) once before breaking when the bind is closed; discard the stale borrowed packet.
derp-borrowed-read-ack.patch.compatibility: Applies at the Tailscale bind lifecycle boundary to plain WG, AWG2, and AWG3 over DERP; wire format, key state, and open-bind receive handling are unchanged.
derp-borrowed-read-ack.patch.removal_condition: Remove after a pinned SagerNet Tailscale revision includes equivalent borrowed-result acknowledgement for a closed bind and the Close/Open regression passes against that revision; recheck on every dependency bump.
